CVE-2026-114713.title: The labeled-response module in UnrealIRCd 6.0.0 before 6.2.7.1 do ...
CVE-2026-114713.description: The labeled-response module in UnrealIRCd 6.0.0 before 6.2.7.1 does not escape the IRCv3 "label" message tag when echoing it into replies, which allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

CVE-2026-90668.title: The webserver in UnrealIRCd 6.0.5 through 6.2.6 before 6.2.7 does ...
CVE-2026-90668.description: The webserver in UnrealIRCd 6.0.5 through 6.2.6 before 6.2.7 does not limit the number of HTTP request headers, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory consumption and unresponsive server) via an HTTP request with an unlimited number of headers, if a websocket or JSON-RPC listener is enabled (disabled by default).
